metadata.method: Source RGB pigment masks inside observed printed areas; morphological closing; simplified connected contours with retained interior holes. Full source image, no preprocessing crop.
metadata.interpretation: Source-derived contours with imagined extrusion heights. A single image does not provide recovered true depth.
metadata.coordinates: u and v in [0,1], origin top-left of ORIGINAL unmodified source. Renderer must apply the same center-cover transform as the original scanner's 9.45 by 6.24 platen.
metadata.areaUnits: source pixels squared, minus retained holes
metadata.heightField: 128 by 48, row-major, v top-down; subdued normalized surface variation.
